name: Milkman Jeeter Infused Pre-Roll | 1g
description: Milkman, an indica, offers a dry hit with sweet cereal notes and cream. Upon inhale, experience the flavor of captain crunch, while exhale reveals sweet creamy cereal milk notes. The high is balanced, slightly more body-leaning, felt initially in the face, then pulsing lightly through the body, while the mind stays relaxed and focused.
